svg.title: Disorders of puberty pathway: puberty before 8 in girls or 9 in boys is precocious, and splits into two normal variants (isolated premature thelarche and pubarche) and, by random luteinizing hormone, central (GnRH dependent) or peripheral (GnRH independent) precocious puberty; no signs by 13 in girls or 14 in boys is delayed, and splits into constitutional delay (delayed bone age), primary hypogonadism (LH and FSH high: Turner, Klinefelter) and secondary hypogonadism (LH and FSH low: brain causes, Kallmann); each column gives causes and clues, investigations, and outcome or treatment
